scope: Default PR CI; docs-only and label-gated install/SFW jobs are skipped. Ecosystem, preview, security and release workflows are outside this comparison.

cache_controls.cold: Cargo lookup-only with an unused key prefix; pnpm, SDK and native cache restores skipped. All cache saving disabled. Cargo action still sets its normal environment.
cache_controls.warm: Identical exact keys and immutable cache IDs from main. No cache saves or fallback-prefix hits. 14 unique entries, 8 exact Cargo hits, 20 restores per run.
cache_controls.zig: Action cache disabled in every run.
cache_controls.not_controlled: Runner image/tool download caches, package registries and runner allocation.

sampling: One cold pair, two warm pairs. Warm order is before/after, then after/before. Cold order is after/before.
timing: CI elapsed is done.completedAt minus detect-changes.startedAt. Runner time sums job API durations. Initial workflow-dispatch queue time is excluded; subsequent job queues are included.
fixed_duration_model: Replay each workflow dependency graph with identical measured job durations. Omit job queue delays. Remove the shared Rolldown job and measured redundant artifact-download steps. Treat these as estimates, separate from observed elapsed times.

harness_revisions.46e27351c62aaab13b9843d49afb9d3b4f598692: Other runs. Changes the cold Cargo guard to preserve Cargo action environment settings; warm behavior and product files are identical.

excluded.reason: Workflow permission validation failed before any jobs ran.
Benchmark caches were evicted. Exact-hit checks failed; the incomplete run was canceled and excluded.

regular_ci.first_attempt_failure: Windows runner lost communication. The failed job passed on retry without source changes.
